blurb: The Trinity Museum is located on Church Road, just beyond St. Paul's Anglican Church. It dates from 1967 when the house was purchased. The house has four rooms on the first floor and three on the second. The store room/back porch is the admission and craft demonstration area. During the operational season, staff and students demonstrate how to hook a traditional mat using scraps of cloth.
